about.title: Behind every solution, there is a vision.
about.intro: I am Anthony Rivera, a software developer focused on turning business needs into functional, scalable, and sustainable technological solutions.
about.body:
I am interested in building products that solve real problems, combining software architecture, development, experience design, and business vision.

I work with entrepreneurs and companies on projects of different sizes, from one-off developments to technology platforms and long-term products.
